name: Bay Mahj Society
evidence: American Mahjong. All levels of experience allowed but must have had at least Mahj 101. Guided play is available. Bring NMJL card. Food and drink available for purchase. All participants will be entered in a raffle.

name: Donna Eschen
evidence: MAHJONG AMERICA: Mahjong originated in China, and includes Chinese characters, numbers, and symbols on tiles or cards. The regular Elwin Mussell Senior Center program focuses on American mahjong, which is a unique form of the game.

name: Lets Bam Mahjong
evidence: Open Play Mahjong for Beginner to experienced players who understand the basic rules of American Mahjong and can play with guidance. THIS IS NOT A LESSON.
